result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and curb ramps within a residential setting. However, safety is limited by faded crosswalk markings, the absence of dedicated pedestrian signals, and parked vehicles that obstruct sightlines at the crossing.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles are located immediately adjacent to the crosswalk, blocking the visibility between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the intersection where the red car is parked.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk lines are significantly worn, making the pedestrian crossing area less visible to motorists.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The signalized intersection lacks dedicated pedestrian signal heads, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicular lights which may not provide adequate clearance intervals.
hazards.location_in_image: On the utility pole at the corner.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse markings with high-visibility continental (ladder) style markings.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential intersection with row houses, featuring basic pedestrian infrastructure such as sidewalks and a signalized crossing. However, the environment is degraded by faded crosswalk markings, poor pavement quality, and sidewalk obstructions including trash and parked vehicles that limit visibility.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Sidewalk obstruction
hazards.description: Boxes and trash are piled on the sidewalk near the corner, narrowing the accessible path for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side sidewalk near the corner

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicle
hazards.description: A large truck is parked very close to the intersection, blocking sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with basic infrastructure including sidewalks and a single traffic signal. However, the crosswalk markings are faded, and there are no dedicated pedestrian signals or curb extensions to enhance safety.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk lines are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection is signalized for vehicles but lacks dedicated pedestrian signal heads, creating ambiguity for crossing pedestrians.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corners may block the view between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs approaching the intersection.

interventions.description: Replace faded transverse lines with high-visibility continental or ladder-style markings.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to improve sightlines.

result.summary: This is a signalized residential intersection featuring high-visibility continental crosswalks and continuous sidewalks. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like signals and ramps are present, the lack of curb extensions and the presence of parked cars near the crossing may impact visibility and safety.

hazards.name: Parked vehicle sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked very close to the crosswalk on the right side of the image obstruct the view between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection along the curb

hazards.name: Wide curb radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry appears to allow for relatively high-speed right turns by vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the intersection in the foreground

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.
